title: Write the main job in JTBD grammar and WMBTs in ODI grammar

facts.note: Planner decomposition phase (framing the main job, deriving WMBTs) is not currently emitted as an observable phase fact.
Plan/wagon/WMBT artifacts under plan/ are identifiable by path and schema.
Writing or editing a job statement or WMBT.
Whether a main job has been substituted by an ODI outcome statement (premature collapse) requires language judgement; missing wmbt.schema fields could be detected mechanically by schema validation.

fires: Planner writes the main job statement for a wagon/plan
Planner authors or edits WMBTs (direction, dimension, object_of_control, context_clarifier)
A main job statement is written as an ODI outcome statement instead of verb + object + contextual clarifier
doesNotFire: Editing plan prose unrelated to the job statement or WMBTs
Coder implementing code or tests from an already-decomposed plan
Acceptance-criteria wording that is neither the main job nor a WMBT

given: You are decomposing work into a main job and its WMBTs in plan/ artifacts
when: you write the main job statement or a WMBT
then: State the main job in JTBD job-statement grammar (verb + object + contextual clarifier) and each WMBT in ODI outcome grammar (direction + dimension + object_of_control + context_clarifier), keeping the two grammars separate.
prefer: Main job as a JTBD statement: verb + object + contextual clarifier (e.g. 'Listen to music while commuting').
WMBTs as ODI outcomes filling the wmbt.schema fields: direction + dimension + object_of_control + context_clarifier.
avoid: Premature collapse: stating the main job as an outcome too early (replacing the job statement with an ODI outcome statement).
Mixing the grammars: writing WMBTs as job statements instead of ODI outcomes.
why: Collapsing the job into an outcome too early produces malformed plan/ artifacts, so the two grammars must stay separate.
evidence: The main job statement is structured as verb + object + contextual clarifier and is not substituted by an ODI outcome statement (direction + dimension + object_of_control + context_clarifier).
Each WMBT populates direction, dimension, object_of_control and context_clarifier per wmbt.schema.
verifier_detail: jtbd term: Jobs-To-Be-Done job statement = verb + object + contextual clarifier (e.g. 'Listen to music while commuting').
odi term: Outcome-Driven Innovation outcome = direction + dimension + object_of_control + context_clarifier — these are the wmbt.schema fields.
premature_collapse term: stating the main job as an outcome too early; forbidden because it yields malformed plan artifacts.
audit: Source statement text: 'Collapsing job into outcome too early produces malformed plan/.' (plan/ artifacts).

trace.note: term id kept as label in verifier_detail and audit
